description.en: Explain purpose, participants, time, and access without inventing additional eligibility conditions.

description.en: Frame a custom as a person’s experience rather than a claim about an entire country or culture.
description.hi: रिवाज को व्यक्ति के अनुभव की तरह बताएँ, पूरे देश या संस्कृति के दावे की तरह नहीं।

description.en: Use man with a singular verb while keeping the generalization limited to the described setting.

meaning.en: For this meeting, register beforehand, give your name at entry, then choose a free seat. The steps concern this fictional meeting.

description.en: Distinguish arranging an action from permitting it using the stated context, not the verb alone.
description.hi: केवल क्रिया नहीं, दिए संदर्भ से काम करवाना और अनुमति देना अलग करें।

examples.text: Lea beauftragt eine Druckerei: Sie lässt die Einladungen drucken. Amir erlaubt den Gästen freie Sitzwahl: Er lässt sie selbst wählen. Der Kontext zeigt Veranlassen oder Erlauben.

meaning.en: Lea commissions a printer to print invitations. Amir allows guests to choose seats themselves. Context distinguishes arranging from permitting.
